notes.title: August Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Please take a moment to read over the patch notes. This month a lot of work was done on the back end. This was mainly to get the game out on all platforms so less real new content. I also finished the last of the quality of life (QoL) changes I was aware people wanted. At this point I am moving away from backend stuff and this sort of QoL work and move forward with content being more of the work. I will still address bugs as they come up, and optimizations where I can, but they will take up a much smaller portion of the work.

New Content:

1.      Finished Localization. As far as I am aware, everything is localized.

2.      New Axe Weapons

Bug Fixes:

1.      A silly sound spawned when you got to the game over screen… FIXED!

2.      Fixed FOV resetting with certain items like the spyglass

3.      Fixed the Mouse inversion uninverting whenever settings were saved

4.      Crashing when transitioning to the mountain area.

Looking Ahead:

1.      Controller Support is indefinitely on hold

2.      A quest in the underground caverns involving a bear

3.      More ways to take out the lava golem

4.      Fixing the quest involving the lich fight

5.      Quest involving the lost Ents and some armor

Thanks @everyone!

 

-Fleece

notes.title: July Update
notes.content:
July Update Patch Notes! 
Hello everyone! Please take a moment to read over the patch notes. For July I spent some time testing TCL on Unreal 4.27 so I can get it on the Epic Games Store, but still managed to get some good work done:
New Content:
1.      Some more content and a quest located in a later level ||Tartarus is the later level getting the revamp and the quest is more of an event, which is a gauntlet of enemies||

2.      A new enemy! The Wasp

3.      Some new settings for player preferences: FOV and mouse inversion

4.      More Voice over, and added subtitles to VO that didn’t have any
Bug Fixes:
1.      There was some crashing from enemies dying and the game treating them as alive… FIXED!

2.      More enemy names and description mixups… FIXED

3.      Still working on Optimizations. The game should run a little smoother in general because I have made many of the transitions between areas into their own streaming levels.
Looking Ahead:
1.      August update will be the engine upgrade. If I can’t solve all the problems with the new engine I may have to cancel Epic Games Store

2.      Continuing working back from the endings filling out empty areas. Plus Quests!!

3.      Still hunting down lag spikes loading levels and music

4.      Controller Support is still a maybe at this point

Thanks @everyone!

 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924228/d0316a299a9fc2ef792dd599fe2836b0f69c5525.gif"]
-Fleece

notes.title: June Update
notes.content:
# June Update Patch Notes!

Hello everyone! Please take a moment to read over the patch notes. Because of unforeseen events the release of my game was missing some of the work I did in late April and May. I have added that and more. Plus, with some of the early feedback I have made changes and fixed some bugs.

## New Content:

1.      Updated the intro area so It is now more instructive and better lit

2.      Most of the voice over is now in the game

3.      Some small level tweaks

4.      First pass of the localization started. TEXT ONLY

## Bug Fixes:

1.      Saving and Loading – there was a bug when loading enemies that caused crashing that has been fixed. This should not affect prior save files, but to be safe start a new file. If it continues, please notify me

2.      Some enemy’s names and descriptions were pulling incorrectly from a table of values. This should be fixed

3.      Some saving and level transition Optimizations

## Looking Ahead:

1.      I am going to upgrade the engine soon, as it is a requirement for some of the games online presence. I have done it on a separate machine, This may cause new problems but I will be on top of it!

2.      Further optimizing the game. There are 2 things I would like to address. One is some machines have occasional hitches due to loading music. The other is I am very aware of the large lag spikes between levels and working on it. I have already cut this problem down significantly.

3.      More Content!! There are some areas of the game that are more unfinished than others, I am focusing on those most for now. Mostly endgame stuff and will work backwards.

4.      Controller Support is a big maybe at this point, but I will start some initial tests in the next couple of months

Thanks @everyone!

 

**-Fleece**
